page0.text:
"Haah..."
My body still feels heavy.
I need to make lunch for Sakura, but right now I want to lie down for a little while and give my mind a break.

page1.text:
...
I flop onto the futon and bury my head in the pillow.

page2.text:
...I know.
Ever since that day, we've run out of time to stall any longer.
I can't keep putting off the question.
Sakura.
I need to decide what I'm going to do, right here, right no—

page4.text:
"Who's there!?"
I jump out of bed.
A voice. I'm sure I heard a voice.
It came from within this room, very close by.

page5.text:
"Ngh."
A chill runs down my spine.
...The scary thing is, I know the owner of the voice is in here, and I still have no idea where it is.

page6.text:
"Your caution is unwarranted. I am not here to kill you."
Someone whispers in my ear.
This voice.
The flowing yet robotic way of talking belongs to that skull-masked Servant.

page7.text:
"Assassin."
...What a disaster.
Even if he specializes at stealth, how'd he manage to slip through the house's Bounded Field and get this far without anyone noticing!?

page8.text: "...You aren't here to kill me? Is this a social call, then?"

page9.text:
I search for the presence I felt behind me while judging the distance to the door.
It'll take three seconds to leap across the room to the hallway and dive into the yard.
Assassin could kill me four times in that span of time.
...Meaning that the only way to survive this is to entertain him.

page10.text:
"Not by me. My Lord Mage desires a meeting."
"Lord Mage? You mean Zouken?"
"Yes. He is waiting for you at the Matou home. He has no desire to fight you. If you go alone, then I believe he will welcome you as a guest."

page11.text:
...
...Assassin's words are believable.
If his goal was to kill me, I would've been dead as soon as he entered the room.

page12.text:
The fact that it hasn't happened yet means that Zouken wants to talk.
What he wants to talk about and whether it's a trap are separate issues.
